text:
Priya: Heads-up: the LlamaIndex + Next samplekit that we ship in QuickStarters is causing onboarding friction. New devs hitting it in the workshop see intermittent "401 -> retry -> duplicate model call" behavior during chunked uploads + eval runs.
Alex: repro?
Priya: steps: clone starter, yarn, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, run `yarn dev`, upload docs via the UI which does chunked calls to `/api/index`, then run `yarn eval` against the sample prompt. After ~10 minutes the background token rotation kicks in and some indexing requests are retried twice. Billing shows two short calls.
Tom: are we sure it's the SDK retry middleware and not upstream transient 401s? Any logs?
Priya: logs attached (snip):

```
[09:18:05] token-manager: rotating token -> new exp=2025-03-01T09:23:05Z
[09:18:06] http: POST /v1/index/chunk (req=ix-77) -> 401
[09:18:06] retry: queued req ix-77 attempt=1
[09:18:06] http: POST /v1/index/chunk (req=ix-77) -> 401
[09:18:06] indexer: chunk failed, marking partial
```

Yara: looks similar to another auth-race bug. What SDK/version?
Priya: using `@redwood/sdk` 0.9.3 in the sample. The monorepo tests with 0.10-preview did not reproduce.
Alex: quick theory: chunk upload uses parallel promises; one promise triggers token refresh path while another observes 401 and triggers immediate retry before token manager finishes updating header. Two in-flight requests => double calls.
Tom: that would explain duplicate billing and eval false negatives (non-deterministic results). For workshops we want deterministic evals.
Yara: quick mitigation options?
Alex: a few: 1) serialize chunk uploads (slow) 2) add a short mutex around token refresh so concurrent requests wait 3) disable retries for local dev/eval runs via env `REDWOOD_RETRY=0` 4) backport the 0.10 jitter/wait behavior to 0.9 line.
Priya: can we make the samplekit default to `REDWOOD_RETRY=0` in the `.env.local.example` with an explanatory comment? New devs will then get deterministic runs.
Tom: yes please. Also add a tiny `scripts/check-retries.js` that simulates parallel chunk uploads with toggled delay so maintainers can reproduce quickly.
Yara: for long term, we should include an integration test in CI that runs the indexer with simultaneous chunks and ensures no duplicate external calls. I'll file a ticket.
devex-bot: Recommend docs note: "If you run samples locally and see intermittent 401s that produce duplicate calls, set REDWOOD_RETRY=0 for deterministic evals. See issue #4394."
Priya: action list: - Priya will open PR to update `.env.local.example` and add `scripts/check-retries.js` - Tom will add a short note in sample README about local retry setting - Alex will prototype a minimal mutex around token refresh in the sample to show maintainers how it can be done (dev-only) - Yara files CI test ticket.
Alex: one more ask: can we include a one-line snippet in the README showing how to instantiate the client defensively? e.g. `const client = new RedwoodClient({ retry: { maxRetries: Number(process.env.REDWOOD_RETRY || 2) } })`
Priya: good idea — I'll add it. Thanks all, will ping when PRs are up. :rocket:
